reviews.author: Tyrian 1997
reviews.text: Recommended to anyone visiting Lombok. Amazing service with Aji who looked after my family and made our holiday seemless and enjoyable! An honest, trustworthy person who I now consider a family friend. Cannot thank you enough for your kindess. Looking forward to seeing you again ❤️

reviews.author: Mesut S.
reviews.text: We are so grateful that we met and had Muhajir as our local guide in Lombok. He helped us from our arrival until our departure the whole 3 weeks. To find the right accommodation,  to visit the beautiful places and for everything else you need for a comfortable stay in Lombok.  We highly recommend Muhajir as your tour guide.

reviews.text: Pioneers who God willing will develop

reviews.author: Kevin Brinkschulte
reviews.text: Große Empfehlung! Der Service war einfach klasse und ich freue mich riesig, ihn für meinen nächsten Trip nach Lombok wieder zu treffen.
